capabilities: Extract URLs from note body into a footer
Add a configurable separator between body and footer
Run extraction via ribbon icon or command
disambiguation: Not a footnotes editor; it only moves URLs from the note body into a footer.
extras: README documents a known issue: footlinks inside block quotes are not parsed by Obsidian, which the author treats as an app bug. Docs mention a development roadmap hosted on another page.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to move inline URLs out of note text into a footer, so links clutter the reading body.
summary: Tool that extracts URLs from the main text of a note and moves them into a footer section of links.
